content:
While you can't create a data access policy with cross-account identity or cross-account collections,
you can still set up cross-account access with the assume role option. For example, if account-
a owns a collection that account-b needs access to, the user from account-b can assume
a role in account-a. The role must have the IAM permissions aoss:APIAccessAll and
aoss:DashboardsAccessAll, and be included in the data access policy on account-a.

hierarchy.parent: Data access control for Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
